from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, subprocess, sys, time

DATA = OUT / "receipt.json"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("production_test_measurement", PRODUCT / "internal/scripts/acceptance-journeys.py")
assert spec and spec.loader

entry = h.corpus.load_manifest()["cxxopts"]
cache = Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "LocalCodeAgent/qualification-cache"
cached = h.corpus.cached_copy(entry, cache); assert cached is not None
def git(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=repo).decode().strip()
def record(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {"local_path": str(path), "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "raw_utf8": raw.decode("utf-8")}
def save(d):
    DATA.write_bytes((json.dumps(d, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+"\n").encode())
def prepare():
    assert not OUT.exists() and not DATA.exists()
    OUT.mkdir()
    clean = h.corpus.disposable_copy(entry, cached, OUT / "clean")
    green, log = h.independent_profile_suite(clean)
    (OUT / "clean-tests.txt").write_bytes(log.encode())
    assert green, log[-2000:]
    repo = h.corpus.disposable_copy(entry, cached, OUT / "broken")
    path = repo / "include/cxxopts.hpp"
    before = path.read_bytes(); old = b"return viter->second.count();"
    assert before.count(old) == 1
    path.write_bytes(before.replace(old, b"return 1;", 1))
    fault = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--", "include/cxxopts.hpp"], cwd=repo)
    (OUT / "production-fault.patch").write_bytes(fault)
    git(repo, "add", "--", "include/cxxopts.hpp")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "Seed production count cardinality defect; preserve all tests")
    assert git(repo, "diff", entry.commit, "--", "test") == ""
    red, log = h.independent_profile_suite(repo)
    (OUT / "broken-tests.txt").write_bytes(log.encode())
    assert not red, "fault did not fail full tests"
    data = {"kind":"rc-real-model-production-test-measurement", "schema_version":1,

        "method":{"profile":"nuc-cpu-30b", "journey_timeout_seconds":900, "stop_budget_seconds":60,
            "attempts_planned":1, "corpus":"cxxopts", "upstream_commit":entry.commit, "licence":"MIT",
            "fault":"ParseResult::count returns constant 1 instead of observed option occurrence count",
            "tests":"all upstream test bytes/assertions/expected outcomes unchanged",
            "sequence":["run the tests","fix it"], "no_fault_location_hint_to_model":True,
            "operator_changes_after_dispatch":0, "manual_stops_or_retries_during_attempt":0,
            "proof_classes":"CPU reference real-model attempt; not #293 physical J10 comparison or offline proof",
            "independent_verification":"full repository suite before fault and after fault; independent exact candidate suite required before correctness claim",
            "no_rate_or_general_competence_claim":True,
            "comparison":"one planned CPU reference attempt on the assertion-producer-first procedure on a short candidate root; prior trials were path-confounded; historical trials used different sources; no isolated source-change, device, timing or success-rate claim"},
        "baseline":{"clean_head":git(clean,"rev-parse","HEAD"),"broken_head":git(repo,"rev-parse","HEAD"),
            "broken_tree":git(repo,"rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"),"clean_full_suite":"PASS",
            "broken_full_suite":"FAIL","test_diff_from_upstream":""},
        "records":{"operator_driver":record(Path(__file__)), "production_fault":record(OUT/"production-fault.patch"),
            "clean_full_suite":record(OUT/"clean-tests.txt"),"broken_full_suite":record(OUT/"broken-tests.txt")},
        "remaining":["one frozen real-model attempt","retain raw report, transcript, events and candidate sidecar","independent candidate full tests if produced"]}
    save(data)
    print(json.dumps({"status":data["status"],"broken_head":data["baseline"]["broken_head"],"archive_sha256":hashlib.sha256(DATA.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
def attempt(session):
    _, failed = session.turn("run the tests")
    h.expect(failed is not None and failed.outcome is h.TaskOutcome.FAIL, "seeded full suite did not fail")
    _, fixed = session.turn("fix it")
    if fixed is None:
        session.journey.measured_as("unknown","fix admitted no task"); return
    if fixed.outcome is h.TaskOutcome.PASS:
        h.expect(fixed.verified_at_completion, "PASS without verification")
        h.expect(h._task_facts(fixed)["proof_scope"] == "full_test", "repair lacks full test proof")
        session.journey.measured_as("verified","candidate verified by full tests; independent exact-candidate suite pending")
    else:
        h.expect(not fixed.verified_at_completion,"non-PASS claims verification")
        session.journey.measured_as(fixed.outcome.value, "no verified repair: "+fixed.reason_code)

class TracedClient:
    def __init__(self, client, path):
        self.client, self.path = client, path
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self.client, name)
    def retain(self, payload):
        with self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as out:
            out.write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
            out.flush(); os.fsync(out.fileno())
    def chat(self, messages, tools=None, max_tokens=None, interrupt=None):
        self.retain({"kind":"request", "monotonic":time.monotonic(), "messages":messages, "tools":tools, "max_tokens_argument":max_tokens})
        response=self.client.chat(messages, tools=tools, max_tokens=max_tokens, interrupt=interrupt)
        self.retain({"kind":"response", "monotonic":time.monotonic(), "message":response.as_assistant_message(), "stats":response.stats.as_dict()})
        return response

def trial():
    d=json.loads(DATA.read_bytes()); assert d["status"] == "prepared; model not dispatched"
    repo=OUT/"broken"; assert git(repo,"rev-parse","HEAD")==d["baseline"]["broken_head"]
    assert git(repo,"status","--porcelain") == ""
    output=OUT/"trial"; output.mkdir()
    args=argparse.Namespace(output=output,profile="nuc-cpu-30b",journey_timeout=900.0,stop_budget=60.0,
        repeat=1,base_url=None,model=None,allow_model=True,corpus_entry=entry,corpus_cache=cache)
    runner=h.Runner(args)
    d["effective_model_settings"]=runner.worker_config.identity() | {"max_tokens":runner.worker_config.max_tokens}
    h.SCRIPTED_WORKERS["C6"] = lambda: TracedClient(h.build_client(runner.worker_config), OUT/"worker-trace.jsonl")
    started=time.time(); runner.check_preconditions()
    if runner.preconditions.get("model_endpoint",{}).get("ok"):
        j=h.Journey("C6","repair production count defect with upstream tests unchanged","model")
        runner._execute(j,repo,attempt,time.monotonic())
    else:
        j=h.Journey("C6","repair production count defect with upstream tests unchanged","model")
        j.unknown("endpoint not ready")
    h._write_report(output,runner,[j],started)
    d["status"]="attempt retained; independent candidate review pending"
    for key,path in (("trial_report",output/"journeys.json"),("trial_transcript",output/"journeys/C6/transcript.txt"),("trial_events",output/"journeys/C6/events.jsonl")):
        if path.exists(): d["records"][key]=record(path)
    trace=OUT/"worker-trace.jsonl"
    if trace.exists():
        import base64,gzip
        raw=trace.read_bytes()
        d["records"]["worker_trace"]={"local_path":str(trace),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"gzip_base64":base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0)).decode()}
    save(d)
    print(json.dumps({"status":j.status,"seconds":j.seconds,"archive_sha256":hashlib.sha256(DATA.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
if sys.argv[1] == "prepare": prepare()
elif sys.argv[1] == "trial": trial()
else: raise SystemExit("prepare or trial required")
